_README: Ground truth for each captured pane, decided by READING the fixture, not by
running a regex over it — an expectation derived from the same pattern it
checks proves only that the pattern equals itself.
Every entry names the line that decides it, so a future reader can re-judge
the call without re-deriving it. Panes were captured from live sessions with
scratchpad/collect.py; the RECONSTRUCTED one is built from an operator
screenshot of a layout the collector never happened to catch.

status4_spin0_shells0_prompt0_e4c334.pan.why: THE KNOWN GAP, recorded honestly rather than hidden. The agent panel below the status line lists a live-looking row — '◯ general-purpose  Reading OagResearchArgs.tsx round-2 anchors' — while the main loop sits at an empty prompt with no spinner and no shells. Today that is false, matching the deliberate decision not to trust anything agent-related until it is shown to clear. If a future capture proves that row disappears when the agent finishes, this expectation flips to true and the pattern goes in. Until then this fixture pins the CURRENT behaviour so the gap cannot be forgotten.

This is the independent confirmation that the RECONSTRUCTED fixture was not wishful; the collector found it on its own. Working here is FOREGROUND: a spinner with a timer, 11 lines up, matched against the whole tail so its distance does not matter.
